profile.jobTitle: Sr. Software Engineer – Automation, Functional and Non-Functional Testing

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer – Automation, Functional and Non-Functional Testing
positions.description:
Responsibilities include designing, building, testing, debugging and documenting analog beam steering radar system for safe automated driving and aerial navigation.
•	Diagnose, debug and perform root-cause analysis of issues and defects.
•	Implement Test Design, Review, Test Execution and Test Documentation.
•	Manage Gitlab for company users.
•	Setup and configure Linux PC, remote devices, boot SD cards for testing, company and customer’s use.
•	Implement a GUI application (frontend and backend) using Python and PyQt5 to control a robot arm to test the radar’s azimuth, elevation and polarization.
•	Implement new features for 3D GUI radar using C++, ImGui and OpenGL.
•	Implement, execute and maintain automated regression test suites using Pyrhon and opensource xdotool.
•	Implement CI/CD pipeline for delivering a new version of radar’s 2D/3D GUI and control applications.
•	Implement shell scripts and work with Linux in command line environment using grep, vi...
•	Participate in application planning meetings (SCRUM).
•	Do radar field (freeway, city, parking lot…) testing.
positions.insights: Skills: Manual Testing · Test Automation · Software Development

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description:
- Researched, designed, coded and debugged the Digital Cable and IP Set-top Box System Terminal.
- Enhanced the set top box by adding Diagnostics, API and subtitles.
- Researched, designed, coded and debugged the Video Graphics Engine (HAL) for new phases.
- Managed Test Design (smoke, sanity, integration, performance, regression, automation, etc.), Review, Test Execution and Test Documentation in effort to ensure that the Set-top Box developed is robust, maintainable, and of high quality.
- Responsible for the verification, certification and validation of Set-top Box and applications.
- Diagnosed, debugged and performed root-cause analysis of issues and defects.
- Maintained, supported and extended existing in-house automation framework and automation suite.
